It should typically fade shortly after removing the pads. To reduce skin irritation: Make sure your skin is clean and dry before use. Avoid placing pads on irritated or damaged skin. Rotate pad placement between treatments. Reduce treatment intensity if the sensation feels uncomfortable. Replace electrodes when the gel becomes old or irritating.
